statement: The function returns a result r and does not fail. Let a mountain array mean an array with len(arr) >= 3 for which there exists an index i with 0 < i < len(arr)-1 such that (for every j with 0 <= j < i, arr[j] < arr[j+1]) and (for every j with i <= j < len(arr)-1, arr[j] > arr[j+1]). Then r = true if and only if arr is a mountain array; equivalently, r = false if and only if arr is not a mountain array.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 10^4 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 0 <= arr[i] <= 10^4.
